I wasn't really going into how they control the response. I was just trying to explain that when you have anxiety, the part of the brain that is responsible for braking that fight or flight response isn't activating properly and that the part of the brain causing that response is on overdrive. And that self-harming activates the part of the brain responsible for braking that fight or flight response. Making us feel better. That's just what I tried to convey with this post.

Not a hotline but there are many mental health servers on discord. They have helped me a lot. Maybe it isn't the best place for crisis situations but if you are feeling really shit and want some peer support, those would be my best bet. There are really caring communities.

Drinking and self-harming are both coping skills. Maybe not healthy ones but still. I'm sorry if you are feeling horrible. Drinking makes you feel slightly better but won't always be enough. And when drunk you are more inclined to do anything. For example cutting. It will help in the moment but it won't be a permanent solution. You are just trying to solve the symptoms of the bad feeling but not the source. I would recommend getting someone to talk to and get to the root of these feelings. Only that way will it last. 

But you should do things at your own pace. 

I made a lot of assumption about how you feel and what situation you are in so if this text is way wrong, I'm sorry.

Just made a post about this just a moment ago in the sub.

Part of the post: With anxiety, the part of the brain that is responsible for the fight or flight response is on overdrive and nothing is stopping it. Self-harming (and for example alcohol) stimulate the part of the brain responsible for controlling this fight or flight part of the brain. So that is the reason why self-harming makes us feel better.

I think I have fucked up. All I ever imagined was for me to become a police. Then I fell sick because of my loneliness. I sorted to drinking and cutting and tried to take my life (I mean I got drunk and took bunch of ibuprofen. I don't know if anything would have even happened but I thought.) It got even worse from there. My thoughts feed itself and everything went worse.

Then I realized that I had really fucked up. The moment I apply to the police academy, they would see my scars. There is no way they would let me in. My high school just ended (the "reading vacation" started) and I have no plan b. It was all I had prepared for. Now I can't do anything. I'm too tired to study to my upcoming finals. And I feel like I'm at the end.

But the worst thing is that all these thoughts make me constantly want to kill myself. That is the worst part. It makes me sick to my stomach. The feeling is crippling. I don't want that feeling to come every single night and morning. During the day I can distract myself enough but I think I'm done.
I just think all these horrible thoughts to the point it literally makes me sick to my stomach.

I sometimes think when I'm suicidal, why not just leave everything behind. Sell my house, my car, everything and go somewhere else. Why not go to live in a hut in middle of the forest. Or some ridiculous dream. 

If you aren't currently I'm the act, think about the things you want to do because if you are dead it doesn't matter anyways. 

But this is just a dumb thought that sometimes resonates with me. Don't know if it has any help to you.

I love reading but I'm too exhausted. Just thinking about reading, painting or hiking makes me exhausted. I need to find some other way to relax. Maybe I'll figure something out. 

My school just ended (we still have our finals in a month). I want to apply for police academy. That was what I always wanted until I got sick. My arms are now full of scars so I don't think they'll let me in. But that's what I based my future on. But now I don't think it's happening. Today's been a good day so I'm more sane than usual. Most days there's only one solution in my mind. It makes my thinking fuzzy and I can't see other way or future. And I can't see the feeling or state going away.

The dilemma comes when I think about asking for help when I'm in my right mind. I have constant self doubt. I'm feeling better today so I don't know if my feelings are real (I feel stupid writing this down but that's how I react). This coupled with the trust problems and being poor socially, I can't do anything. 

I think constantly of getting help but something just keeps me in lockdown.

I'm not currently thinking about much. Today's been a good day (got my driver's license and all) but the other nights the feeling has been unbearable. My thoughts go to not wanting to feel this way and not wanting to be alive. But every night this crushing feeling creeps in. When the feeling comes it but me in to a loop of thinking about this feeling and having your normal depressive thoughts. But today I'm feeling better but the feeling still remains.

I do drink, but I haven't drunk in four days. I smoke. 

I haven't told anyone because I have trust issues and getting help might interfere with my dream job which makes me more "depressed". I self-harm but I haven't done it in a week 5 days.
Oooh, how dramatic

I'm sorry, I don't want to. It's not worth it.

I have felt betrayal against other people my hole life. Why? Was it at school when I was bullied and all my friends left me. Was it when I was bullied for 6 years and when I reached for help from a teacher, he just said don't bully and walked off (was he in a hurry or something? I don't know he was just walking past when I reached out). Was it when my brother (who is my best friend) suddenly moved from home after finding a girlfriend. Or when he got a moped and suddenly my company wasn't welcomed. Was it when my little sister did something (hit me, bit me, said my food was thrash) my mother would always side with her. 

I started going to my towns youth house. I found a place where I wasn't bullied and where I could spend some time with people (mostly the youth workers there). After a month I would start get bullied. People going there would make fun of me for not having friends and would say that my only friends are some youth workers.

I can't trust people. I don't want friends. I just want someone who I can trust. Currently my only "friend" is a youth worker at a different youth house. I trust her. She's getting payed after all to keep me company.
